title: UDP, DCCP: Use follow_stream_tap_listener
description:
The packet_info structure contains the *last* value of the addresses
and ports on a frame. The follow tap should get the addresses and ports
and the stream_id at the time of tapping, which means that using the
packet_info structure is inaccurate when there is tunneling.

This ensures that the follow tap doesn't receive data from extra streams
other than the one intended, and that tap data is correctly assigned to
the server or client side, even in the case of tunneling.

Fix #18231
